# ProbaDeck

> ProbaDeck is an open-source TypeScript library for deterministic deck simulation and explainable exact probability calculations over partially known decks.

The website contains a static project overview, complete API documentation, and interactive examples for Texas Hold'em, Magic: The Gathering, and Yu-Gi-Oh! The probability engine is game-independent and reports exact fractions with structured explanations.

## Primary pages

- [Project overview](https://probadeck.com/)
- [Documentation and API reference](https://probadeck.com/docs/)
- [Interactive examples](https://probadeck.com/examples/)
